About Organization

The Bank of India is a public sector bank in India. It was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Mumbai.

The bank has a long history of providing banking services to its customers. It has a wide range of products and services, including credit cards, loans, and deposit accounts.

About the Programme

The Bank of India Credit Officers Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity. The recruitment process is ongoing, and the application deadline is 20 July 2026.

The programme is designed to recruit credit officers for the bank. The selected candidates will be responsible for evaluating credit applications and making decisions about loan approvals.
